ex.en: The government plans to implement the new policy early next year.
ex.zh: 政府计划明年年初实施这项新政策。

words.note: implement 作动词重音在首音节；名词是 implementation。

ex.en: The police asked the crowd to disperse after the concert ended.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束后，警察要求人群散去。

words.note: disperse 与 scatter 近义，disperse 更正式，多指人群散开。

ex.en: Quick action by the pilot averted a serious accident.
ex.zh: 飞行员的果断操作避免了一场严重事故。

words.note: avert 后接灾难类名词表避免；avert one's eyes 是移开视线。

ex.en: He still lives in a fantasy world where everything goes his way.
ex.zh: 他仍活在一切顺他心意的幻想世界里。

words.note: fantasy 指脱离现实的想象；形容词 fantastic 意为「极好的」。

ex.en: The shipment of coffee beans arrived two weeks later than expected.
ex.zh: 这批咖啡豆比预期晚了两个星期到货。

words.note: shipment 兼指「装运」和「所运的货物」；动词是 ship。

ex.en: Cutting prices led to a vicious circle of falling profits.
ex.zh: 降价导致了利润下滑的恶性循环。

words.note: vicious circle 恶性循环，是六级常见固定搭配。

ex.en: She laced up her boots and stepped out into the snow.
ex.zh: 她系好靴子，走进了雪地里。

words.note: lace 作名词指鞋带、花边；作动词常与 up 连用。

ex.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and money.
ex.zh: 这个项目需要投入大量的时间和金钱。

words.note: enorm-（巨大）；enormous 可修饰具体或抽象事物。

ex.en: The report was written by an external expert, not a company employee.
ex.zh: 这份报告由外聘专家撰写，并非公司员工。

words.note: extern-（外部）对应 internal（内部）；也指「外来的」。

ex.en: From the top of the hill we had a gorgeous view of the valley.
ex.zh: 从山顶上，我们看到山谷的绝美景色。

words.note: gorgeous 口语中常表「极好的」，语气比 beautiful 强。

ex.en: Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不应不锁门就离开。

words.note: under no circumstances 置于句首时，句子要部分倒装。

ex.en: Only the manager has the authority to approve such large payments.
ex.zh: 只有经理有权批准这样的大额付款。

words.note: authority 表权力、权威；the authorities 指官方当局。

ex.en: Planting trees along the river helps slow down soil erosion.
ex.zh: 沿河种树有助于减缓水土流失。

words.note: e-（向外）+ ros（咬）→ 逐渐侵蚀掉；动词 erode。

ex.en: The balloon slowly ascended into the clear morning sky.
ex.zh: 气球缓缓升入晴朗的晨空。

words.note: a-（向上）+ scend（爬）→ 上升；反义词 descend。

ex.en: You can borrow the car provided that you return it by six.
ex.zh: 你可以借用这辆车，只要你六点前还回来。

words.note: provided (that) 引导条件从句，比 if 更正式。

ex.en: The piano is the only instrument she has ever learned to play.
ex.zh: 钢琴是她唯一学过演奏的乐器。

words.note: instrument 指工具、仪器或乐器；instrumental 表「起作用的」。

ex.en: English serves as a medium of communication at many international meetings.
ex.zh: 英语在许多国际会议上是交流媒介。

words.note: medium 复数为 media；a medium-sized 表「中号的」。

ex.en: A good dictionary is indispensable to anyone learning a foreign language.
ex.zh: 一本好词典对学外语的人来说必不可少。

words.note: in-（不）+ dispens（免除）+ -able → 不可或缺；后接 to。

ex.en: He cleaned the lens of his camera before taking the photo.
ex.zh: 拍照前他擦干净了相机的镜头。

words.note: lens 复数 lenses；contact lenses 指隐形眼镜。

ex.en: The old bridge is said to embody the history of the small town.
ex.zh: 据说这座老桥体现了这个小镇的历史。

words.note: em-（使进入）+ body → 使理念具象化、体现。

ex.en: One fatal mistake in the experiment destroyed months of careful work.
ex.zh: 实验中一个致命错误毁掉了数月的细致工作。

words.note: fatal 表致命的；fate 是命运，fatal 也可指决定性的。

ex.en: The police could find no motive for the attack.
ex.zh: 警方找不到袭击的动机。

words.note: motive 后接 for 表动机；动词 motivate，形容词 motivated。

ex.en: Few people could envisage such rapid changes in technology.
ex.zh: 很少有人能预见到技术如此迅速的变化。

words.note: envisage 后接名词或动名词，不接 to do；美式常用 envision。

ex.en: Managers continue to wrestle with the problem of staff shortages.
ex.zh: 管理者仍在努力应对人手不足的问题。

words.note: wrestle 作名词指摔跤；wrestle with 引申为竭力应对。

ex.en: Good teachers know how to motivate students to work on their own.
ex.zh: 好老师懂得如何激励学生自主学习。

words.note: motivate sb to do sth；motivated 表「有积极性的」。

ex.en: The new tax made only a marginal difference to most families.
ex.zh: 新税对大多数家庭只产生了微小的影响。

words.note: margin（边缘）+ -al；marginal cost 指边际成本。

ex.en: Heavy rain spoiled our plan for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 大雨打乱了我们湖边野餐的计划。

words.note: spoil 过去式有 spoiled 和 spoilt 两种；兼指宠坏与破坏。

ex.en: If you multiply six by four, the answer is twenty-four.
ex.zh: 六乘以四，答案是二十四。

words.note: multiply A by B 表 A 乘以 B；也表「繁殖、增加」。

ex.en: The cows were moved to a new pasture with fresh grass.
ex.zh: 牛群被转移到了一片长着新草的新牧场。

words.note: pasture 指牧草地；greener pastures 引申为更好的去处。

ex.en: The plan cannot go ahead without the approval of the board.
ex.zh: 没有董事会的批准，这个计划无法推进。

words.note: approve of 表赞成；名词 approval 常与 give、win 连用。
